system.name: Spectre
system.summary: Ecosystem manifest for @phcdevworks/spectre-init — workspace scaffolding CLI for Spectre-aligned projects.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.description: Base design-system packages and adapters that higher layers build on.

build.title: Build
build.description: Composition and application-facing packages built on top of the foundation layer.

@phcdevworks/spectre-init.description: Workspace scaffolding entrypoint for creating new Spectre-aligned projects.
notes: If spectre-init starts consuming governance packages later, it should move into a tooling/governance layer or receive an explicit boundary exception.
Scaffolding logic only — must not import from the runtime Spectre packages it generates.
Build packages may compose foundation packages and collaborate within the build layer.

boundaryConstraints.rule: Scaffolding logic only — no runtime Spectre package imports.
boundaryConstraints.reason: spectre-init generates project scaffolding; importing the packages it scaffolds would create circular coupling.

generationRules: Do not add runtime Spectre package dependencies to this package.
Edit templates in templates/ to change scaffolded project output.
Run npm run check before staging any commit.
usageGuidance: Run npx @phcdevworks/spectre-init to scaffold a new project.
Templates live in templates/ — edit there to change generated output.
This package is a CLI tool only; it does not publish a runtime JS/TS API.
safeDefaults: Do not import from spectre-tokens, spectre-ui, or other Spectre runtime packages.
Keep the CLI dependency footprint minimal.
Do not add a Spectre design or UI dependency to this scaffolding package.
